name: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA)
description: SFMOMA is one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the United States, featuring an expansive collection of painting, sculpture, photography, architecture, design, and media arts in its distinctive building in downtown San Francisco.
fullDescription: SFMOMA is one of the largest museums of modern and contemporary art in the United States, featuring an expansive collection of painting, sculpture, photography, architecture, design, and media arts in its distinctive building in downtown San Francisco.
whatTheyOffer:
- Ages 18 and under: Always free
- Museums for All: Free for San Francisco residents with Medi-Cal, CalFresh, SNAP, or EBT (up to 4 adult tickets, including special exhibitions)
- Military: Free general admission with active military or veteran ID, plus one guest; free for up to five guests during Blue Star Museums (Armed Forces Day through Labor Day)
- Free Community Days and Free Family Days throughout the year
- Discover & Go: Free passes through participating Bay Area libraries
- Regular admission: $30 adults, $25 seniors 65+, $23 full-time students
howToGetIt: Youth 18 and under get free admission. For Museums for All, bring your benefits card and proof of San Francisco residency on the day of your visit. Military tickets are same-day, walk-up only at the ticketing desk. Check your library for Discover & Go passes. Free Day tickets are released online in advance. The museum is closed Wednesdays.
